theme_and_archetype.description: Engineered, precise, and authoritative. Reflects 'agents that prove their work'. Avoids all flashy/cosmic AI tropes. Focuses on structural borders, mono-spaced data, and terminal-like audit logs.

fonts.heading: Chivo
fonts.import_instructions: Import these fonts from Google Fonts via @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chivo:wght@400;600;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap'); in index.css

rules: Never center-align hero or large text blocks. Asymmetry and left-alignment create tension and precision.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all audit logs, timestamps, stack badges, and data points.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid. Use strict grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Apply border-collapse or 1px border on all grid items.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for containers (p-8 to p-12) but dense data grouping inside (gap-2, gap-4).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Use asymmetric grid spans (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layout_and_spacing.borders: No border-radius. Use rounded-none for a sharp, technical, B2B engineering feel.

buttons.primary: bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent hover:bg-zinc-900 text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none border border-zinc-700 transition-colors duration-200

cards.base: bg-zinc-950/50 border border-white/10 rounded-none p-6 backdrop-blur-sm

navigation.style: Glassmorphism with optical clarity: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70 border-b border-white/10. Include RU/EN toggle.

audit_log_motif.description: Visual element replacing standard images. A simulated terminal streaming verification actions: '[VERIFIED] Invoice #3292 matched with PO' using IBM Plex Mono and subtle emerald green highlights. Use framer-motion to animate new lines appearing.

home.hero: Left-aligned heavy typography. Subhead in mono font. Right side features the animated 'audit log' terminal motif instead of an image.
home.problem: Stark contrast. Darker background section. Large bold text emphasizing the hallucination problem in AI.
home.how_it_works: 3 steps (Verify, Escalate, Audit) placed in a 3-column strict grid with visible borders.
home.use_cases: Strip cards horizontally scrolling (use standard CSS scroll snap or react-fast-marquee).
home.track_record: Bento grid (Control Room layout) of proof cards showing pipelines and systems.

founder.layout: Terminal/IDE aesthetic. Bio text left-aligned. Strict list format for projects. Use react-icons (SiPython, SiAmazonaws, SiGooglecloud, SiNextdotjs, SiDocker, SiN8N, SiTensorflow, SiPytorch) for stack badges.

admin.layout: Centered strict login box on a near-black screen. Upon login, a data-dense table view for waitlist emails using Shadcn Table component.

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react for UI icons (Chevron, Check, AlertCircle). react-icons/si for tech stack logos.
media_and_icons.images: NO STOCK PHOTOS. Rely entirely on typography, 1px structural borders, and the code/audit-log visual motif.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='early-access-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design remains strictly B2B and technical. Do not add decorative gradients or blurry glowing orbs (except subtle button hovers).
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing section layouts to maintain asymmetry, and Shadcn for interactive pieces (Forms, Inputs, Table).
Strictly follow the color palette. Violet-600 is the main action color.
Do not use generic border-radius. Use rounded-none for a sharp, precise look.
